name: io.github.liujiaao/es-plus
description: Generate runnable Vue 3 / Vue 2 CRUD pages from one JSON config or a natural-language request.

environmentVariables.name: ESPLUS_MCP_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Tool surface to expose: `full` (default, 19 tools) or `front-door` (13 tools — the generate_scene scene router (crud/table/form/dialog), generate_composition, and the deterministic support tools). The front-door profile hides the entries generate_scene reproduces byte-for-byte — generate_crud, generate_form / generate_table / generate_dialog, the legacy generate_crud_schema and the advanced generate_crud_from_config — cutting per-turn tools/list from ~341 KB to ~22 KB.
